g1_to_g2_upgrade_discriminator.finding: The green stable-bound-file donor changes the meaning of unifieddb_authority_receipt_sha256. Existing G1 rows contain the historical full-fingerprint receipt and are rejected if G2 interprets the same bytes as the new stable bound-file receipt. Fresh G2 success therefore does not establish update compatibility.
